title: Trees and bushes are alpha-tested leaf cards, never a solid crown
note: Trees and bushes are built from alpha-tested leaf cards, never a solid crown; a foliage helper you write (for example makeTree/makeBush in src/foliage.js) is the recipe.
intent: A crown made of one sphere, icosahedron or capsule reads as a boulder on a stick from every camera, and no material fixes it. Build the canopy from six or more crossed quads carrying a leaf texture with alphaTest around 0.5 (not plain transparency, which needs sorting and shows as a grey haze), scattered on the branch ends with random yaw and a little scale jitter, and let the silhouette break: gaps between the cards are what makes it read as leaves. The template ships this as foliage.js makeTree({ height, spread, seed, kind }) and makeBush({ radius, seed }); a mesh modelled in Blender and loaded with loadAsset counts as built from parts and passes the same check.

check.js: (() => { const trees = [...objects('tree'), ...objects('bush')]; if (!trees.length) return false; return trees.every(t => { if (t.userData && t.userData.asset) return true; let cards = 0, solids = 0; t.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const m = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material[0] : o.material; if (m && (m.alphaTest > 0 || m.transparent)) cards++; else if (/Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(o.geometry?.type ?? '')) solids++; }); return cards >= 6 && solids === 0; }); })()
check.detail: (() => { const trees = [...objects('tree'), ...objects('bush')]; let cards = 0, solids = 0, modelled = 0; for (const t of trees) { if (t.userData && t.userData.asset) { modelled++; continue; } t.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const m = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material[0] : o.material; if (m && (m.alphaTest > 0 || m.transparent)) cards++; else if (/Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(o.geometry?.type ?? '')) solids++; }); } return 'trees+bushes: ' + trees.length + ', alpha-tested leaf cards: ' + cards + ', solid canopy primitives: ' + solids + ', modelled in Blender: ' + modelled + ' (need >= 6 cards per tree, 0 solids)'; })()
check.note: Every object tagged tree or bush is built from alpha-tested leaf cards (≥ 6 meshes with alphaTest/transparent) and carries no sphere/icosahedron/capsule canopy. A solid crown reads as a boulder from every camera — a foliage helper you write (for example makeTree/makeBush in src/foliage.js) is the recipe. A modelled asset (userData.asset, set by the project's asset loader) counts as built from parts.

port: The facet that owns vegetation uses its own foliage helper (or loads a modelled asset), tags each tree `tree` and each bush `bush`, and never adds a solid primitive under those tags.
